SOURCE:
[[PW0:001]]
LLM safety can be wiped by deleting one 'refusal direction' — this paper fights back with a decoy, notable even with just 1 HF upvote today.
[[PW0:002]]
• Method: Decoy Direction Optimization (DDO) injects a high-magnitude nonlinear decoy into MLP neurons to corrupt RFA estimation.
[[PW0:003]]
• Result: <10% ASR under standard Refusal Feature Ablation across six model families.
[[PW0:004]]
• Result: On Llama-3-8B-Instruct cuts Heretic attack from 88.7% to 18% and holds 65% vs 58% worst-case vs trained defenses.
[[PW0:005]]
• Why it matters: post-hoc weight edit with no finetuning at 30-450x lower cost for open-weight releases.
[[PW0:006]]
Paper: https://t.co/JMODFS9XZa
[[PW0:007]]
Code: https://t.co/dxjIZHQ3DQ
[[PW0:END]]

raw_text:
[[PW0:001]]
LLM安全性可能因删除一个“拒绝方向”而被摧毁——这篇论文用诱饵进行反击，即便今天在HF上仅有1个赞也值得关注。
[[PW0:002]]
• 方法：诱饵方向优化（DDO）向MLP神经元注入高量级非线性诱饵，以破坏RFA估计。
[[PW0:003]]
• 结果：在六种模型家族的标准拒绝特征消融下，ASR低于10%。
[[PW0:004]]
• 结果：在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上，将Heretic攻击从88.7%降至18%，并在最坏情况下比训练过的防御保持65%对比58%的优势。
[[PW0:005]]
• 为何重要：后验权重编辑无需微调，成本降低30-450倍，适用于开放权重发布。
[[PW0:006]]
论文：https://t.co/JMODFS9XZa
[[PW0:007]]
代码：https://t.co/dxjIZHQ3DQ
[[PW0:END]]
